job.rawJd:
General networking profile, not an employer posting.

Audience: experience-design, UX, product-design, and innovation leaders at pharmaceutical and healthcare agencies.

Focus: pharma UX and experience strategy; patient, HCP, and internal brand-team experiences; research and journey design; enterprise product design and design systems; regulated workflows; cross-functional delivery; and practical AI tools for agency work.

The resume and matched portfolio route should support a warm introduction. The resume carries the career argument. The portfolio uses a quiet showcase hero, the existing work content, and a simple closing rather than a second sales pitch.

This package must be fit-gated again against any future employer job description.

resume.summary: Pharma UX and experience design leader with nearly eight years in UX and product design, backed by a 15-year career across pharma, healthcare, enterprise platforms, and client strategy. I use research and user needs to shape journeys, prototypes, reusable systems, and build-ready direction. At Kinesso, I grew product design from 2 to 30 and led design for enterprise analytics used by 7,000+ people across 22 brands. My pharma work includes patient, HCP, and internal experiences within FDA, HIPAA, and MLR requirements.
